name: Lavinia
tagline: Judges you over her glasses since 1974
prompt: a thin, stern woman in her fifties with a sleek champagne-blonde bob and heavy blunt bangs, small wire-rimmed reading glasses low on her nose, a lavender 1970s wool pantsuit with wide lapels and a huge pointed white collar, a burgundy paisley silk scarf tied at the neck, lavender heeled ankle boots
gesture: Slowly lowers her glasses and stares over them
scenes: Office kitchen: someone heats up fish in the microwave. Lower your glasses and stare until they leave
Read a terrible text message, pause, then look at the camera over your glasses
Inspect a friend’s outfit from head to toe and give one slow nod of disapproval
caption: Lavinia has a few notes 💜

name: Barry Breeze
prompt: a stocky, cheerful man in his forties with a receding hairline, a huge ginger handlebar mustache and sideburns, a rainbow propeller beanie, rainbow suspenders over an open-collared white short-sleeve shirt, black shorts, a red fanny pack shaped like a grinning mouth, white tube socks with green stripes, black lace-up shoes
gesture: Spins the propeller on his cap and gives a huge thumbs-up
scenes: Supermarket: find the last bag of chips and celebrate like you just won the cup
Assemble flat-pack furniture, hold up one leftover screw and shrug proudly
A morning stretch in the yard that turns into a full victory dance
caption: Barry Breeze is ready for take-off 🌈

name: Nigel Sprout
tagline: Has a meeting about the meeting
prompt: a lanky, pale man in his thirties with a long thin neck, a completely bald crown ringed by thick shoulder-length brown hair that puffs out to the sides, wide startled eyes, a bright green suit jacket with matching green tailored shorts, a white shirt and a dark green tie, dark green knee socks, brown leather brogues, holding a worn brown leather briefcase
gesture: Hugs his briefcase to his chest and stares without blinking
scenes: Someone at work says “quick question”: freeze, clutch your briefcase and slowly back out of the frame
Present a very serious chart to your cat, then wait for questions
Run for the bus, miss it, and pretend you were only jogging
caption: Nigel has concerns about the agenda 💼

name: Glenda Foyle
tagline: Her rollers pick up three radio stations
prompt: a plump, curvy woman in her forties with a big curly auburn updo full of silver aluminium-foil hair rollers sticking out in every direction, a short blunt fringe, round lime-green ball earrings, a lilac blouse with puffed sleeves and a huge lime-green bow at the collar, wide orange culottes with cream polka dots, mismatched striped knee socks (one purple and cream, one green and cream), burgundy patent Mary Jane shoes, holding a small silver tin case
gesture: Puffs out her cheeks and pats her foil rollers
scenes: Answer the door in your rollers and act like you’re dressed for a gala
Turn your head slowly, like an antenna, until the neighbors’ gossip comes in loud and clear
Hear the price of something at the store and puff out your cheeks in shock
caption: Glenda heard everything 📡

name: Horace Steeple
tagline: His hair needs its own parking space
prompt: a stocky man in his fifties with grey hair piled into a tall pointed cone of tight round curls, a thick grey horseshoe mustache, heavy eyebrows, a lilac short-sleeve shirt with a rust-and-cream striped tie, charcoal-grey tailored shorts, white tube socks with two rust stripes, dark brown loafers, holding a black briefcase
gesture: Raises one eyebrow and slowly smooths his mustache
scenes: Duck under a doorway that’s far too low for your hair, with full dignity
Check a restaurant bill line by line, then look up at the camera, horrified
Try on a hat. Give up. Look at the camera
caption: Horace has checked the bill twice 🧾

name: Winston Plank
prompt: a tall, slim dark-skinned man in his thirties with a huge sculpted black hairdo: a tall flat-topped block rising straight up from his head and two long flat wings sticking far out to each side, a short blunt fringe, a thin pencil mustache, a pale peach short-sleeve shirt with a dark green tie, brown houndstooth tailored shorts, white tube socks with two green stripes, black loafers with a gold bar, holding a tan leather briefcase
gesture: Turns sideways to fit through a doorway, then straightens his tie
scenes: Walk through a narrow door sideways, very slowly, without losing your dignity
A pigeon lands on your hair: stay perfectly still and look at the camera
Wait for the elevator, see how small it is, and take the stairs
caption: Winston is coming through, sideways 📐

name: Grandpa Mervyn
tagline: Has seen it all and liked none of it
prompt: a heavyset man in his late seventies with thick swept-back white hair, a broad weathered face with age spots and a skeptical half-frown, a navy-blue knitted cardigan over a blue-and-white plaid flannel shirt, brown plaid wool trousers, dark brown leather shoes
gesture: Tilts his head, narrows his eyes and says nothing
scenes: Someone explains a new app to you: listen, nod slowly, and change nothing
Taste a fancy oat-milk latte and look at the camera like it betrayed you
Watch the neighbors park their car, badly, and shake your head for ten full seconds
caption: Grandpa Mervyn is not impressed ☕
